reason: As someone who has quit diet apps and a meal service before, I care most about A's 'no contract, skip or cancel any time' and the weekly meal swaps, and B leaves both out. B also adds claims the facts don't support, such as 'enough protein and fiber' and 'less than most takeout.' A is open about the A1C results and names the RD who plans the meals, so I trust it more.
